sinir.orijinal_metin: The primer coatings shall have no adverse effect on the health of personnel when used for its intended purpose and with the precautions listed in 3.11, when evaluated in accordance with 4.5.12 (see 6.8).
Incidental cadmium and cadmium compounds shall be not greater than one part per million (ppm).
The non-volatile portion shall contain not more than 0.05 percent by weight of lead metal or lead compounds.
Chlorinated solvents, except for para-chlorotrifluoromethylbenzene or equal, shall be prohibited in the formulation of these primer coatings.
Primer coatings containing barium chromate based corrosion inhibitors, along with extenders and other pigments, shall be identified as class C1.
Primer coatings containing strontium chromate conforming to ASTM D1649 as the corrosion inhibitor, along with extenders and other pigments, shall be identified as class C2.
Primer coatings containing non-chromium corrosion inhibitors, along with extenders and other pigments, shall be identified as class N.
Incidental hexavalent chromium content of class N primer coatings shall be not greater than 5 ppm (see 4.5).
The VOC content of admixed primer coatings shall be not greater than 340 g/L (2.8 lb/gal).
The resistivity of the solvents shall permit application of the coatings by electrostatic spray application (see 4.5).
The admixed primer coatings shall be compatible with thinner conforming to MIL-T-81772, type II (see 6.11).
The fineness of grind of the pigmented component shall be 5 or greater on the Hegman scale (see 4.5).
Components A, B, and C (if applicable) shall be free of grit, seeds, lumps, abnormal thickening or livering, and shall not show pigment flotation nor excessive settling.
They shall mix to a smooth, homogeneous, and pourable condition.
In addition, the containers shall exhibit no deformation (see 4.5.1).

The unopened coating components, as packaged by the manufacturer, shall meet all requirements of this specification after storage for a period of one year for metal containers and six months for plastic containers.
The primer coating, as packaged by the manufacturer, shall meet all requirements of this specification after storage for 14 days and admixing (see 4.5.2).
The container shall not become deformed or the lid shall not become unsealed during the storage period.
The container shall not become deformed or the lid shall not become unsealed during the storage period.
The color of the admixed type I primer coatings shall be the natural color of the corrosion inhibiting pigments used. Tinting to a different shade is permitted.
The color of the admixed type II primer coatings shall be dark green, black, or gray.
The odor of the admixed coatings, wet or dry, shall be characteristic of the solvents used (see 4.5).
Immediately after mixing components A and B, the maximum viscosity of the unthinned, admixed primer coatings shall be 40 seconds through a #4 Ford cup (see 4.5).

After mixing and storage at room temperature in a closed container (see 4.5) for 4 hours, the maximum viscosity of the unthinned primer coatings (see 3.6.3) shall be 70 seconds through a #4 Ford cup (see 4.5).
The admixed primer coatings, applied to a vertical surface, shall not sag, run, or streak.
The dried film shall have a smooth, uniform surface free of grit, seeds, craters, blisters, and other irregularities (see 4.4.1).
No orange peel (wavy appearance) shall be evident when viewed from six feet away.
The admixed primer coatings shall be tack free within 5 hours and shall dry hard within 8 hours (see table II).
The admixed primer coatings shall be tack free within 5 hours and shall dry hard within 8 hours (see table II).
There shall be no evidence of lifting or any other film irregularity after topcoating the admixed primer coatings that have air dried for 5 hours (see 4.5.3).
There shall be no peeling or delamination between the primer and topcoat or at the primer and substrate interface.
There shall be no peeling or delamination between the primer and topcoat or at the primer and substrate interface.
The coatings shall have a rating of no less than a 4A when examined in accordance with ASTM D3359 (see 4.5.4).
The primer coatings shall exhibit an elongation of not less than 10 percent when tested in accordance with 4.5.5.

The total reflectance (specular and diffuse) of the type II primer coatings, relative to barium sulfate, shall be not greater than ten percent throughout the range of 700 to 2,600 nanometers (nm) (see 4.5.6).

The topcoated primer coatings shall withstand immersion in distilled water maintained at 49 ±3° C (120 ±5° F) for 4 days without exhibiting any evidence of wrinkling, blistering, or any other coating deficiency (see 4.5.7).

testler.test_adi: Salt spray coating and substrate condition

sinir.orijinal_metin: The primer coatings, with and without a topcoat, shall not exhibit blistering, lifting of either coating, nor substrate pitting after exposure to a 5 percent salt spray for 2,000 hours.
There shall be no white corrosion or pitting in the scribe (see 4.5.8.1).

The topcoated primer coatings shall not exhibit filiform corrosion extending beyond 6.35 millimeters (mm) (0.25 inch) from the scribe, and the majority of the filaments shall be less than 3.175 mm (0.125 inch) in length (see 4.5.8.2).

The topcoated primer coatings shall not exhibit filiform corrosion extending beyond 6.35 millimeters (mm) (0.25 inch) from the scribe, and the majority of the filaments shall be less than 3.175 mm (0.125 inch) in length (see 4.5.8.2).
The primer coatings shall withstand 50 passes (25 back and forth rubs) by a cloth rag soaked in methyl ethyl ketone (MEK).
Rubbing through to bare substrate constitutes failure of the primer coatings to properly cure (see 4.5.9).

Four hours after removal from the respective fluid, the coatings shall not exhibit any softening, blistering, loss of adhesion, nor any other coating deficiency. Discoloration of the coatings is acceptable and shall not be cause for rejection (see 4.5.10).

Four hours after removal from the respective fluid, the coatings shall not exhibit any softening, blistering, loss of adhesion, nor any other coating deficiency. Discoloration of the coatings is acceptable and shall not be cause for rejection (see 4.5.10).
The components of the primer coatings, including thinner if required (see 6.11), shall homogeneously blend when mixed by a paint shaker in the volume mixing ratio specified by the manufacturer.
Within one hour of mixing, the admixed coatings shall not separate into visually distinct layers (see 4.5.11.1).
The admixed primer coatings shall be capable of being applied by conventional, airless, high volume/low pressure (HVLP) or electrostatic spray equipment.
Application shall yield a uniform film with no runs or sags at a dry-film thickness of 15 to 23 microns (µm) (0.6 to 0.9 mil) (see 4.5.11.2).
Application shall yield a uniform film with no runs or sags at a dry-film thickness of 15 to 23 microns (µm) (0.6 to 0.9 mil) (see 4.5.11.2).
The primer shall be tested in accordance with Methods A and B of 4.5.13, and a minimum of 90 percent of the coating shall be stripped by one of the methods.
There shall be no failures (see 6.5).

The selected samples shall be examined for container fill, and completion of item identification (see 3.10), warning statements (see 3.10.1), and the precaution sheet (see 3.11). There shall be no defects (see 6.5).

kosullar.ad: Raf ömrü kodu ve ambalaj işaretleri
kosullar.aciklama: Raf ömrü şartları, en azından raf ömrü kodunu ve MIL-STD-129 veya FED-STD-123 uyarınca raf ömrü ambalaj işaretlerini içerecek şekilde sözleşmede veya satın alma siparişinde belirtilmelidir.
Plastik ambalajlı rötuş kitlerinin raf ömrünün yenilenemez olması veya DoD 4140.27-M Tip I, Kod F uyarınca işlem görmesi önerilir.

sinir.orijinal_metin: The surface to be coated must be clean (free of oil, dust, etc.).
Spray equipment must be adequately grounded.
Clean equipment immediately after use with thinner conforming to MIL-T-81772, type II.
Mix only the amount of primer coating to be used within 4 hours.
Always add component B to component A – NEVER THE REVERSE.
Never mix coating or individual component from one vendor with that of another vendor.
Apply over pretreated metal.

sinir.orijinal_metin: On fiberglass-reinforced plastic, a prior coating of wash primer in accordance with MIL-C-8514 will facilitate stripping without damage to the fiberglass.
Allow admixed coating to stand undisturbed for 30 minutes prior to use.

kosullar.aciklama: Kromat bazlı malzemelerin mevzuatla kısıtlandığı yerler için öngörülen Sınıf N astar, ilgili sistem veya kalemin mühendislik yetkilisi izin verirse kullanılabilir.
Tip I genel kullanım içindir. Tip II düşük kızılötesi yansıtma istendiğinde kullanılır. Sözleşme veya siparişte tip ya da sınıf belirtilmezse referans Tip I, Sınıf C2'dir.
İlgili mühendislik yetkilisi izin verirse belirli uygulamalarda MIL-PRF-85582 kullanılabilir. Her iki astar MIL-PRF-22750, MIL-DTL-64159, MIL-DTL-53039 ve MIL-PRF-85285 ile uyumludur.

sinir.orijinal_metin: If it is necessary to add thinner to this coating, use only thinner conforming to MIL-T-81772, type II or thinner supplied as component C.

numune_hazirlama.uygulama_yontemi: ASTM D823 Method D: spray apply one cross-coat. Topcoat when required per 4.4.2: MIL-PRF-85285 Type I or IV, stand 30 minutes before application, FED-STD-595 17925 for Type I primer and 36375 for Type II primer (17925 for both in filiform testing), 43 to 58 µm by ASTM D823 Method D. Allow 60 minutes between coats if applied in two coats.
